// ── 1. Release model — add UPC ────────────────────────────────
// In model Release { ... } add:
//   upc         String?    // Universal Product Code — auto-generated on upload

// ── 2. Track model — add ISRC ────────────────────────────────
// In model Track { ... } add:
//   isrc        String?    // International Standard Recording Code — auto-generated

// ── 3. ArtistBankAccount model (if not exists) ────────────────
// model ArtistBankAccount {
//   id            String         @id @default(cuid())
//   artistId      String
//   artist        Artist         @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
//   accountHolder String
//   bankName      String
//   branchCode    String         @default("")
//   maskedNumber  String         // e.g. "****4321"
//   accountType   String         @default("current") // current | savings
//   isDefault     Boolean        @default(false)
//   isVerified    Boolean        @default(false)     // admin-verified before payouts
//   createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())
//   payoutRequests PayoutRequest[]
//   @@index([artistId])
// }

// ── 4. PayoutRequest model (if not exists) ────────────────────
// model PayoutRequest {
//   id            String             @id @default(cuid())
//   artistId      String
//   artist        Artist             @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id])
//   bankAccountId String
//   bankAccount   ArtistBankAccount  @relation(fields: [bankAccountId], references: [id])
//   amount        Float
//   method        String             @default("eft") // eft | payfast | ozow | yoco
//   status        String             @default("pending") // pending | approved | processing | completed | rejected
//   note          String?
//   adminNote     String?
//   processedAt   DateTime?
//   createdAt     DateTime           @default(now())
//   @@index([artistId])
//   @@index([status])
// }

// ── 5. Notification model (if not exists) ────────────────────
// model Notification {
//   id        String   @id @default(cuid())
//   userId    String
//   user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
//   type      String   // new_sale | new_follower | new_comment | new_like | new_message | new_post | milestone_followers | milestone_sales
//   title     String
//   body      String
//   isRead    Boolean  @default(false)
//   linkType  String   @default("") // post | artist | beat | release | message | sale
//   linkId    String   @default("") // the id/slug to navigate to
//   createdAt DateTime @default(now())
//   @@index([userId, isRead])
//   @@index([userId, createdAt])
// }
